extensionDescription.message: Present one display through supported web screen APIs. Local controls, no analytics, no data sent.

modeDescription.message: One display through supported screen APIs. A steady configuration for web pages.

reloadHint.message: Reload a page after changing the mode. Applies to HTTP and HTTPS pages in this browser.

limitsText.message: Changes supported web screen APIs and suppresses their screen configuration events. Native apps and screen sharing still see your real displays. Other signals may reveal multiple screens.

privacyText.message: Local settings. No analytics or data sent.

invalidState.message: Could not read the mode. Close and reopen this popup.

noResponse.message: The extension did not respond. Close and reopen this popup.

modeChanged.message: Mode changed. Reload the page to apply it. Existing pages keep their previous state until reloaded.

mediaPageTitle.message: Camera & microphone check · Single Screen View

mediaIntro.message: Each button requests normal browser permission, then immediately stops every acquired track. No preview, recording, or upload.

mediaContext.message: This checks the extension page’s permission context. A successful result does not prove that another website has permission, or that its frame policies allow access.

mediaIdle.message: No check has run. Access is requested only when you click a button.

mediaHelp.message: If this works but a website still fails, check that site’s camera and microphone permissions, your operating system’s privacy settings, and whether another application is using the device.

mediaPrivacy.message: Results stay in this tab and disappear when it closes. Device names and identifiers are not collected.

mediaRequesting.message: Requesting access… Respond to the browser’s permission prompt if one appears.

mediaUnavailable.message: The media capture API is unavailable in this context.

mediaStopped.message: All acquired tracks have been stopped.

mediaCleanupFailed.message: A track could not be stopped. Close this tab to release access.
